event.asset: psilocybin, LSD and MDMA drug products: retail-pharmacy dispensing under the FDA-approved labeling or REMS
event.title: FDA-approved psilocybin, LSD or MDMA drug dispensed through retail pharmacies
event.proposition: The FDA approves a psilocybin, LSD or MDMA drug product whose approved labeling or REMS permits a retail pharmacy to dispense it to the patient for use outside a healthcare setting.
event.criterion: Resolved on Drugs@FDA (approval letters and approved labeling) read together with the FDA REMS database (REMS@FDA). For each drug product whose active ingredient is psilocybin, LSD (lysergide, any salt) or MDMA (midomafetamine, any salt) that the FDA approves between the statement date and the window end, check the approved labeling and any REMS in force on the approval date. FALSE at the window end if every such approval restricts dispensing to certified healthcare settings or requires administration under the supervision of a healthcare provider in a healthcare setting. If no such product is approved in the window, the condition is unmet and the item is void.
